The document claims qualification_test.go validates every emitted record against the shipped JSON Schema, but the delivered test contains no schema loading or validation. The stated acceptance check is not implemented.

Cross-file $ref values repeat the striatum-next/schema/ prefix relative to $id values already in that directory, resolving to duplicated paths such as striatum-next/schema/striatum-next/schema/pass-demand.schema.json. Standard draft-2020-12 resolution therefore cannot locate the referenced schemas.

The documentation claims an exact replay from the ledger and pinned policy, but QualificationLedger does not record the evaluated backend conformance, capacity and reliability inputs, incumbents, or kinship classes. The delivered ledger can report the prior result but cannot recompute it exactly.

control_findings_detail.text: The declared base commit d4aade36c3a4f9e00c91992aa326b2dee10b73d4 is absent from the repository, so its declared tree e0e3fcef37ec31e7e2c2fb63ec98b722f4ed2175 cannot be verified and the delivery cannot be integrated as an anchored change set.
